options.content: **Fahrten:** je Punkt eine Fahrt · **Fenster:** je Punkt 60 Sekunden Fahrt aus allen Fahrten des Zeitbereichs. Achsen und Mindeststrecke stehen oben in der Leiste.

panels.title: Fahrten: ${ty:text} über ${tx:text}

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT ${tx} AS x, ${ty} AS y FROM grafana_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND km >= ${minkm} AND ${tx} IS NOT NULL AND ${ty} IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT regr_slope(y, x) AS b, regr_intercept(y, x) AS a, min(x) AS x0, max(x) AS x1 FROM d) SELECT x AS "${tx:text}", y AS "${ty:text}", NULL::float AS "Trend" FROM d UNION ALL SELECT x0, NULL, a + b * x0 FROM r WHERE b IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT x1, NULL, a + b * x1 FROM r WHERE b IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Jeder Punkt ist eine Auswertungseinheit; die orange Linie ist die lineare Ausgleichsgerade. Achsen oben über die Auswahl wählen.

panels.title: Zusammenhang (Fahrten)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Punkte", round(corr(y, x)::numeric, 2) AS "r", round(regr_r2(y, x)::numeric, 2) AS "R²", round(regr_slope(y, x)::numeric, 3) AS "Steigung" FROM (SELECT ${tx} AS x, ${ty} AS y FROM grafana_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND km >= ${minkm} AND ${tx} IS NOT NULL AND ${ty} IS NOT NULL) t

panels.description: r = Korrelation (−1 bis 1), R² = Anteil der Streuung, den die Gerade erklärt, Steigung = Änderung von Y je Einheit X. Bei wenigen Punkten sind alle drei mit Vorsicht zu lesen; ein Zusammenhang ist keine Ursache.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, time AS "Start", round(km::numeric) AS "km", round((${tx})::numeric, 2) AS "${tx:text}", round((${ty})::numeric, 2) AS "${ty:text}" FROM grafana_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND km >= ${minkm} ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Fenster: ${wy:text} über ${wx:text}

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT ${wx} AS x, ${wy} AS y FROM grafana_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (slope_pct IS NULL OR abs(slope_pct) <= 15) AND ${wx} IS NOT NULL AND ${wy} IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT regr_slope(y, x) AS b, regr_intercept(y, x) AS a, min(x) AS x0, max(x) AS x1 FROM d) SELECT x AS "${wx:text}", y AS "${wy:text}", NULL::float AS "Trend" FROM d UNION ALL SELECT x0, NULL, a + b * x0 FROM r WHERE b IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT x1, NULL, a + b * x1 FROM r WHERE b IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Punkte", round(corr(y, x)::numeric, 2) AS "r", round(regr_r2(y, x)::numeric, 2) AS "R²", round(regr_slope(y, x)::numeric, 3) AS "Steigung" FROM (SELECT ${wx} AS x, ${wy} AS y FROM grafana_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (slope_pct IS NULL OR abs(slope_pct) <= 15) AND ${wx} IS NOT NULL AND ${wy} IS NOT NULL) t

panels.title: Datenbasis

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Fenster", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "Fahrten", round(min(outside_c)::numeric, 1) AS "Außen min °C", round(max(outside_c)::numeric, 1) AS "Außen max °C" FROM grafana_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (slope_pct IS NULL OR abs(slope_pct) <= 15)

panels.description: Die Außentemperatur ist je Fahrt gemittelt: der Dongle meldet sie nur alle paar Minuten.

panels.title: Verbrauch nach Tempo und Außentemperatur (kWh/100 km)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cls AS "Klasse",
       round(avg(kwh100) FILTER (WHERE t = '<10 °C')::numeric, 1) AS "<10 °C",
       round(avg(kwh100) FILTER (WHERE t = '10-15 °C')::numeric, 1) AS "10-15 °C",
       round(avg(kwh100) FILTER (WHERE t = '15-20 °C')::numeric, 1) AS "15-20 °C",
       round(avg(kwh100) FILTER (WHERE t = '≥20 °C')::numeric, 1) AS "≥20 °C"
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN speed_kmh < 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN speed_kmh < 50 THEN '30-50' WHEN speed_kmh < 70 THEN '50-70' WHEN speed_kmh < 90 THEN '70-90' ELSE '90+' END AS cls, CASE WHEN outside_c < 10 THEN '<10 °C' WHEN outside_c < 15 THEN '10-15 °C' WHEN outside_c < 20 THEN '15-20 °C' ELSE '≥20 °C' END AS t, kwh100, speed_kmh FROM grafana_windows
      WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND kwh100 IS NOT NULL AND outside_c IS NOT NULL) q
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY min(speed_kmh)

panels.description: Mittlerer Verbrauch je Tempoklasse (km/h), getrennt nach Außentemperatur. Fehlen Balken, gibt es in der Klasse keine Fenster.

panels.title: Antrieb und Nebenverbraucher nach Tempo (kWh/100 km)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cls AS "Klasse", round(avg(drive_kwh100)::numeric, 1) AS "Antrieb",
       round(avg(aux_kwh100)::numeric, 1) AS "Nebenverbraucher"
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN speed_kmh < 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN speed_kmh < 50 THEN '30-50' WHEN speed_kmh < 70 THEN '50-70' WHEN speed_kmh < 90 THEN '70-90' ELSE '90+' END AS cls, drive_kwh100, aux_kwh100, speed_kmh FROM grafana_windows
      WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND kwh100 IS NOT NULL) q
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY min(speed_kmh)

panels.description: Je langsamer die Fahrt, desto größer der Anteil der Nebenverbraucher am Verbrauch.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cls AS "Klasse", round(avg(aux_kw)::numeric, 2) AS "Ø Nebenverbraucher",
       round(max(aux_kw)::numeric, 2) AS "Maximum"
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN outside_c < 10 THEN '<10 °C' WHEN outside_c < 15 THEN '10-15 °C' WHEN outside_c < 20 THEN '15-20 °C' ELSE '≥20 °C' END AS cls, aux_kw, outside_c FROM grafana_windows
      WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND aux_kw IS NOT NULL AND outside_c IS NOT NULL) q
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY min(outside_c)

panels.title: Verbrauch nach Steigung (kWh/100 km, ab 30 km/h)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cls AS "Klasse", round(avg(kwh100)::numeric, 1) AS "Verbrauch",
       count(*) AS "Fenster"
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN slope_pct < -4 THEN '1: <-4' WHEN slope_pct < -2 THEN '2: -4..-2' WHEN slope_pct < -0.5 THEN '3: -2..-0.5' WHEN slope_pct <= 0.5 THEN '4: flach' WHEN slope_pct <= 2 THEN '5: 0.5..2' WHEN slope_pct <= 4 THEN '6: 2..4' ELSE '7: >4' END AS cls, kwh100 FROM grafana_windows
      WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND speed_kmh >= 30 AND slope_pct IS NOT NULL
        AND abs(slope_pct) <= 15 AND kwh100 IS NOT NULL) q
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY cls

panels.description: Steigung aus dem Höhenunterschied im Fenster (Höhe in ganzen Metern: grob). Bergab sinkt der Verbrauch durch Rekuperation, negative Werte sind möglich.
